text: Hello, I'm Beth.
And I'm Neil.
And this is Real Easy English,
the podcast with real conversations
in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 以简单英语帮助大家学习的播客。
zh_hant: 以簡單英語幫助大家學習的播客。

text: If you want to read along with this podcast,
zh: 如果你想跟着这期播客一起读，
zh_hant: 如果你想跟著這期播客一起讀，

text: you can find a text version on our website.
zh: 可以在我们的网站上找到文字版。
zh_hant: 可以在我們的網站上找到文字版。

text: Visit bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Beth, how are things this week?
zh: 嗨，贝丝，这周过得怎么样？
zh_hant: 嗨，貝絲，這周過得怎麼樣？

text: Things are good, Neil.
How are you?
I'm very well, thank you very much.
Today we're talking all about cooking.
zh: 今天我们聊的都是做饭。
zh_hant: 今天我們聊的都是做飯。

text: We'll talk about what we like to cook,
zh: 我们会聊聊喜欢做什么菜，
zh_hant: 我們會聊聊喜歡做什麼菜，

text: as well as our favourite recipes.
Can you explain the word recipes, Neil?
zh: 尼尔，你能解释一下 recipes 这个词吗？
zh_hant: 尼爾，你能解釋一下 recipes 這個詞嗎？

text: Yes, a recipe is a list of instructions
zh: 可以，recipe 就是一份做法说明清单，
zh_hant: 可以，recipe 就是一份做法說明清單，

text: for how to make certain types of food.
zh: 告诉你如何制作某些类型的食物。
zh_hant: 告訴你如何製作某些型別的食物。

text: OK, great.
Let's get started then.
So, Neil, do you enjoy cooking?
zh: 那么，尼尔，你喜欢做饭吗？
zh_hant: 那麼，尼爾，你喜歡做飯嗎？

text: Yes, I do enjoy cooking.
When I cook, I find it relaxing.
zh: 做饭的时候，我觉得很放松。
zh_hant: 做飯的時候，我覺得很放鬆。

text: How about you?
Yeah, I'm the same.
I cook quite a lot,
but I really enjoy it when I can be in the kitchen
zh: 但我真的很享受待在厨房里，
zh_hant: 但我真的很享受待在廚房裡，

text: with music or a podcast on and really relax
zh: 放着音乐或播客，真正放松下来，
zh_hant: 放著音樂或播客，真正放鬆下來，

text: and spend time making food.
What's your favourite thing to make?
I quite like making stir-fries because they're quick
zh: 我挺喜欢做炒菜，因为它们又快
zh_hant: 我挺喜歡做炒菜，因為它們又快

text: and easy.
There's lots of different ingredients and flavours you can use.
zh: 你可以用很多不同的食材和调料。
zh_hant: 你可以用很多不同的食材和調料。

text: But I also quite like cooking fish.
I've got some good fish recipes.
zh: 我有几个很不错的做鱼食谱。
zh_hant: 我有幾個很不錯的做魚食譜。

text: Ah, OK.
What about you?
I like to cook a roast dinner.
Very British.
Yes, on a Sunday.
Let me tell you how to do roast chicken.
zh: 我来告诉你怎么做烤鸡。
zh_hant: 我來告訴你怎麼做烤雞。

text: OK, give me the recipe.
OK,
take a chicken and put garlic and rosemary and lemons inside.
zh: 拿一只鸡，把大蒜、迷迭香和柠檬塞进去。
zh_hant: 拿一隻雞，把大蒜、迷迭香和檸檬塞進去。

text: Then boil some potatoes,
not too long, and put everything in the oven and roast it with some vegetables
zh: 不要煮太久，把所有东西放进烤箱，和一些蔬菜一起烤
zh_hant: 不要煮太久，把所有東西放進烤箱，和一些蔬菜一起烤

text: for about an hour and 15 minutes.
Sounds really good.
OK, Beth, I want to hear about your fish recipe.
zh: 好，贝丝，我想听听你的做鱼食谱。
zh_hant: 好，貝絲，我想聽聽你的做魚食譜。

text: Well, there's one I like, which is with cod.
zh: 嗯，有一个我喜欢的，用的是鳕鱼。
zh_hant: 嗯，有一個我喜歡的，用的是鱈魚。

text: So, You put the cod in a pan with stock,
zh: 把鳕鱼放进锅里，加上高汤、
zh_hant: 把鱈魚放進鍋裡，加上高湯、

text: creme fraiche, and tarragon.
That's it.
It's really simple.
There's only four ingredients,
but it tastes really delicious.
Sounds amazing.
How does your chicken recipe taste, Neil?
zh: 尼尔，你的烤鸡食谱味道怎么样？
zh_hant: 尼爾，你的烤雞食譜味道怎麼樣？

text: It tastes fantastic, I have to say.
I think especially because of the gravy,
zh: 我觉得特别是因为肉汁，
zh_hant: 我覺得特別是因為肉汁，

text: and the gravy is a sauce made from all
of the juices from the chicken and the vegetables.
zh: 鸡肉和蔬菜流出的汁做成的酱汁。
zh_hant: 雞肉和蔬菜流出的汁做成的醬汁。

text: I love gravy.
I use gravy on my bangers and mash.
zh: 我吃香肠土豆泥的时候会浇肉汁。
zh_hant: 我吃香腸土豆泥的時候會澆肉汁。

text: Bangers and mash.
What's that?
Bangers and mash is another British recipe,
zh: 香肠土豆泥是另一道英式菜，
zh_hant: 香腸土豆泥是另一道英式菜，

text: which is sausages and mashed potato.
The sausages are the bangers and the mash is the mashed potato.
zh: 香肠叫 bangers，土豆泥叫 mash。
zh_hant: 香腸叫 bangers，土豆泥叫 mash。

text: I can almost smell it.
I know, I'm getting hungry.
Let's look at the language we learnt during the conversation.
zh: 我们来看看对话中学到的语言。
zh_hant: 我們來看看對話中學到的語言。

text: We had recipe,
the instructions for cooking a particular food or meal.
zh: 也就是烹饪某种食物或菜肴的说明。
zh_hant: 也就是烹飪某種食物或菜餚的說明。

text: Taste, which we use to describe the food we eat.
zh: Taste，我们用它来描述吃到的食物。
zh_hant: Taste，我們用它來描述吃到的食物。

text: For example, my chicken tastes amazing.
zh: 比如，我的鸡肉尝起来棒极了。
zh_hant: 比如，我的雞肉嚐起來棒極了。

text: And Neil, you gave me instructions on how to make that delicious roast chicken,
zh: 尼尔，你教了我怎么做那道美味的烤鸡，
zh_hant: 尼爾，你教了我怎麼做那道美味的烤雞，

text: and you used the imperative.
You said put lemon,
garlic and herbs in the chicken,
boil the potatoes, but not for too long,
and add them to the dish.
That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这期《简单易学英语》就到这里。
zh_hant: 這期《簡單易學英語》就到這裡。

text: For more on the imperative and other grammar tips,
zh: 想了解更多祈使句和其他语法技巧，
zh_hant: 想了解更多祈使句和其他語法技巧，

text: Try our podcast, Learning English Grammar.
zh: 试试我们的播客《学英语语法》。
zh_hant: 試試我們的播客《學英語語法》。

text: You can find it on your podcast app or by visiting our website,
zh: 你可以在播客应用上找到它，或者访问我们的网站，
zh_hant: 你可以在播客應用上找到它，或者訪問我們的網站，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Next time, we'll talk more about our families and the jobs they do.
zh: 下次，我们会多聊聊我们的家人和他们的工作。
zh_hant: 下次，我們會多聊聊我們的家人和他們的工作。

text: See you then.
Goodbye.
Bye.
